metric_note: fast_p = fraction of tasks with measured speedup > p over the strong automated roofline (min of eager and torch.compile), at fixed fp32-gold correctness. pass@k = fraction of tasks with >=1 correct candidate in k samples. Higher is better.

models.notes: First baseline. Mostly emits broken Triton; rarely beats eager.
Strong curator that calibrates difficulty. Beats the compile roofline by ~1.1-1.5x on most tasks; a few it cannot beat (hard).
